en: So is this bat not the same thing?
Not even close. A compressed bat is thoroughly primed with resin to give your swing more substance.
This isn't treated, see?
Oh, and look, there's not even any pine tar on it. No mistake, this thing is bogus.
Isn't this just a souvenir with a signature?
So you're saying...
Let me think... If you did have to pay, it'd be what, 10,000 yen, tops?
You think you can just waltz in here and try to pull a fast one on me?
If you doubt me, get it appraised.
It's pretty obvious, though.
What's with all the racket in here?
You the guy in charge? Perfect timing.

That "expensive" thing Toriyama-san broke?
It's nowhere near authentic. So...

I was wondering if you could maybe just give him a slap on
the wrist and let that be the end of it?
Care to explain what our guest is saying?
Hey, Ono.
What's this about transporting an expensive commodity?
This's the first I've heard of it.
You see, I uh...
<Italic>What I see</Italic> is a sneaky little rat who took on yet another company job just so he could skim the fee.
No... That's not how I...
Gwaaaaaaaaaaaagh!

I don't care what kind of shenanigans you pull by yourself,
but you don't <Italic>ever</Italic> spoil my company's good name.
Sh... Shorry!

And if what you showed our guest today is how you define
hospitality, then maybe you need another pen to the face!
Whoa, time out!

As long as Toriyama-san's off the hook, I'd be totally happy
without that!
Then a formal apology is called for.
Pleash... I beg your forgivnesh!
Hello. I'm here from Nightlife Magazine...
What's this about?
Uh... Well, I'm Shinada and I write for adult entertainment...
Adult entertainment?
Anyway, I'm here for Milky-chan's little bro.
Milky-chan?

Yes, Milky from Club Futo Momo. Her real name's...
Uh, what was it again?

Forget it. Now if you could release the employee you're
basically holding hostage, that'd be great.
If you mean Toriyama, it ain't none of your damn business.
Now get lost, ya sack of shit!
Friend, all I want is to get Toriyama-san home safe and sound.

I'm not here to stir things up. I just wanna see my buddy
unharmed.
Listen, mister writer. If you don't shut up and shuffle on out this door...
I'll end more than just your career.
Ooh, scary! Did you come up with that one all by yourself?
You fuckin' with us!?
Well... Check out the balls on this bastard. Thinks he's hot shit!
Awright, boys! Teach this asshole who's in charge!

The Tokyo Gigants continue to drift rudderless as their
search for a new manager has yet to turn up any candidates.
Are they stuck on a crash course for disaster this season?
(Come on. Think about work. Gotta get to the club.)
Whew. Made it with no time on the clock.
Okay, let's get down to business.
(Milky-chan's brother's in trouble. I need to get to... Kubota Security? I think that's what it was.)
You know the Tojo Clan and Omi Alliance?
They're big yakuza groups in Kanto and Kansai, right?
Right. Two of their officers, Azumi and Takachi, were found dead today in Kineicho.
Whoa! They were murdered!?
They say accident.
Ouch, that's awful.
So now they gotta collect the bodies and go after whoever caused said accident.
Both sides have people all over this area now.
I liked it here 'cause I never saw any of those types...
At least they're not freeloaders like you. <Italic>They</Italic> pay their bills.
Oh, right. Other than the mob, some weirdo's been sniffing around.
A weirdo?
Some sneaky guy hiding his face with a hat and a mask. Looking for someone in Kineicho.
Better steer clear of crazies like that. Or it could end up dangerous.
Oh, is that a packed house I see?
A counter seat's opening right now.
You really wanna settle this in a crapped-out batting center?
Doesn't matter. The lady at the desk told me you're a regular here. That true?
Must be hard clinging onto your dead baseball dreams.
That's not what this is.
Whatever. This is how we'll do it. Our showdown will go for ten pitches. Hit a homer off one of them and I'll call it a win.
If you fail... you'll be sorry you did.
There. Home run's in the bag.
I thought you threw hard despite your busted shoulder, but that was nowhere near 150 kilometers an hour. That wasn't even close to Akamatsu.
...Can't argue with that. I'm pretty surprised myself. Didn't think my pitching got this bad.
Look, all I need's a little time, and I can restage that duel. I promise.
Did you not just see what happened? There's no way you can pull that off.
I will pull it off! And when I do, I'll expose you for the fraud you are. Don't you dare think this is over.
You really can't shake the past, can you...
Where do you think you're going, Shirakawa!? Weren't you gonna smash Shinada into a bloody pulp?
...Kurosaki. Were you watching this whole time?
Kurosaki? As in the same Kurosaki from high school?
Glad you remember. I hope you know, my life's been complete shit ever since that fucking game.
Man, what is up with today? It's practically raining old teammates up in here.
Shinada. It was Kurosaki who told me where I could find you.
Everyone knew Shirakawa hated you. I honestly thought he was out to take your life, but I guess he couldn't sack up.
Drop it. I'll deal with him my own way.
Tch, what a tool. No⑬that would be disrespectful. Tools are useful.
Oh, so suddenly you hate my guts, too? Why? What'd I ever do to you? And how do you know where I live!?
Listen to all these goddamn questions. What are you, a child!? You completely fucked my job, smart guy!
...I did what?

The home run king's record-setting bat. I was gonna shake
 down this stupid security guard and sell that shit for
good money.

The job itself ain't glamorous, but it took time and effort
to set up, you know? Had to pay off the other security staff
and everything.
Wait a minute... <Italic>You</Italic> were behind that fake bat extortion?
Surprised? Shoulda seen the look on my face when I found out I got <Italic>boned</Italic> by a washed-up hack of a ball player who interviews whores for a living!
Huh, so you rallied Shirakawa to get back at me. What's wrong with you, man? What made you go so bad?
Simple. I'm what you call a broker. Got something to do with baseball? BOOM, I can turn it into big bucks!
Lucky for me, this town has a pro team and plenty of baseball fanatics. There's no shortage of suckers, believe me.
How could you stoop so low...
Now then. You owe me for one wrecked bat heist. I'll make you pay for that soon enough.
Just you wait!
Now, I thought you threw hard despite your busted shoulder, but that was nowhere near 150 kilometers an hour. That wasn't even close to Akamatsu.
Can't argue with that. I'm pretty surprised myself. Didn't think my pitching got this bad.

The home run king's record-setting bat. I was gonna
shake down this stupid security guard and sell that shit for
good money.
Simple. I'm what you call a broker. Got something to do with baseball? <Italic>Boom</Italic>, I can turn it into big bucks!
Hey, Shinada. You better not foul things up like last time.
Think back to twenty years ago and take me on seriously. You'll see what baseball has cost me!
Seems like I can't convince you otherwise. All right then.
This is how we'll do it. Our showdown will go for ten pitches. Hit a homer off one of them and I'll call it a win.
What happened to you?
You're supposed to be better than this, Shinada! You forget how to hold your bat!? This doesn't settle a damn thing!
I'll give you more time. We're going to do this right.
And when the dust has settled, I'll have found you out. So don't go giving me those pathetic swings from last time!
(Oh, a voicemail. It's the office.)
Good evening. Just letting you know, this month's Nightlife Magazine ended up being right on time. Nice going.
People just won't stop talking about your feature on Milky-chan! I'll bet you her club appreciates it, too.

We hope to see more like it next time. Oh, and this is
completely unrelated, but I should tell you anyway...

We received some gifts from one of our affiliates. Can you
make it over tonight?

They'll be gone by tomorrow, so if you'd like some,
I suggest you swing by before we close up shop.
(They even left something for me? Then I might as well stop by.)
But you had the name of the place wrong. We caught it in the nick of time, though.

Even so, you can't just go fumbling up the name of a
business. That looks bad on everyone. So be careful.
Oh, and this is completely unrelated, but...
One of our affiliates left us some goodies. Can you make it over tonight?
I should mention you got the girl's name wrong. We managed to correct the error, but even so. That's poor journalism.

I mean, if the name is wrong, how are customers supposed to
request the girl? Please take this a little more seriously.
But you fudged up the names of both the massage parlor and the girl.

Someone else noticed and fixed them, so there was no damage
done, but even so.

If we can't even get our facts straight, we're useless as an
information source. Seriously, can you be more careful?
That's where we're at. Oh, and this is completely unrelated, but...
(Man... I really blew it, didn't I? So much for calling myself a professional.)
(Still, he said they left me something at the office. At this point, I'll take what I can get.)
(Oh, there's a voicemail. From the office.)

(Takasugi-san can handle Uno-san. I have to hurry and take a
taxi to the port!)
Urgh... Ahh...
Uno-san!?
He's here all right.
What a simpleton.
(I have to hurry up and find Uno-san.)
Huh. The place ain't as tacky as I thought.
Maybe Uno-san's inside. Well, shall we?
(I don't need to drop in now.)
So, there really was match fixing going on...
Who was behind it?
Who'd need to fix matches...?
The answer's simple. My oldest son could figure it out.
The yakuza running the baseball betting?
Oh, he's finally caught up to my son. Grade six.
But even the yakuza lost their gambling business thanks to me.
I can't think of anyone else who would've profited.
Who would be happy to see the yakuza lose their business and leave Nagoya? The local civilians?
No. Right after the Tojo and Omi left, the Nagoya Family sprang up out of the woodwork.
There's always been yakuza around these parts.
Someone <Italic>did</Italic> profit!
Enlighten us.
The Nagoya Family!
Once the Tojo and Omi skipped town, the Nagoya Family swept in and set up shop without any resistance.
Wait, you're saying that homer fifteen years ago⑬that whole mess was orchestrated by the Nagoya Family?
They must've wormed their way into baseball to drive the Tojo Clan and Omi Alliance out of Nagoya.
That's why I was accused of sign stealing, and a faulty home run...
If that's the truth, it's way too hot to handle!
Shinada, I'm telling you as a friend, drop this.
The Nagoya Family, huh? Listen, Takasugi-san, I don't care who we're up against, I don't wanna back down anymore!
Please, introduce me to the head of the Nagoya Family!
Do as Manabe said, and stop digging around for trouble.
Why!? You've got connections with the Nagoya Family, right? Just introduce me to the boss!
Then I'll get my pay and you'll get yours!
Personally, I'd rather put your fingers through a metal press.
Takasugi-san! Forget about my fingers, will you!?
This is about what happened to the rest of me!
Sorry. But I ain't connected to the Nagoya Family... Never even met 'em.
When I came to this town a year ago, I caught wind of a gang that everybody knows but nobody's ever seen.
I learned that just dropping their name made people wet their pants. So I made that my bluff of choice.
Fact is, nobody knows who's running the Nagoya Family or who its members are.
The whole group is an enigma. I can't tell you much else.
So, I didn't need to be scared of you one stinking bit. What a bullshit artist.
Yeah? What the hell do you take me for!?
A loan shark without any teeth to bite! Go ahead, hit me! I'll sue!
Come on, this is no time to fight!

Our path is crystal clear. Get the truth from the head of
the Nagoya Family, and that twenty million yen's as good as
ours!

Then not only can I pay you back, but I can finally learn
who used me.

Yeah, but nobody knows who the Nagoya Family is or who's
in charge. Or if they even exist to begin with.
Well, I don't see any other way.
How are you gonna find them?
